summary.title: MPEC EIENDOM AS

narrative.text: MPEC EIENDOM AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom", registered 2008-04-08.
Registered activity: Investering i fast eiendom, eie og drive fast eiendom og ved aksjetegning eller på annen måte delta i annen virksomhet som står i forbindelse med dette.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 1.2 million and an annual result of NOK 697,206.
Registered leadership: Emil Perisa (Daglig leder); Emil Perisa (Styrets leder).
Head office in Rygge, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
